import copy,json,gzip,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from pcg.prototype.creative_batches.batch30_blockn12 import api_v1 as old,api_v2 as new,counter_policy_v1 as policy
from pcg.prototype.creative_batches.batch30_runtime.produce_v1 import checked_purpose,external_outcome,counter_classification
P=Path('pcg/results/workshop-batch30-blockn12-full-v2/investment-fork');batches=json.load(open(P/'batches.json'));rows=[];raw_binding=[];base={};nominal=[];sample=None
for b in batches:
 if b['stage']not in ['clean-screen','counterexample']:continue
 inp=P/'physics'/(b['batch']+'.input.json');ib=inp.read_bytes();cases=json.loads(ib)['cases'];packed=(P/b['gzip_path']).read_bytes();data=gzip.decompress(packed);assert hashlib.sha256(packed).hexdigest()==b['gzip_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==b['raw_output_sha256'];raw=json.loads(data)['results'];assert len(cases)==len(raw)
 raw_binding.append(dict(input=str(inp),input_sha256=hashlib.sha256(ib).hexdigest(),output=str(P/b['gzip_path']),gzip_sha256=b['gzip_sha256'],raw_sha256=b['raw_output_sha256'],cases=len(cases)))
 for c,r in zip(cases,raw):
  assert c['id']==r['id']
  if b['stage']=='clean-screen':base[c['id']]=r;nominal.append(dict(case_id=c['id'],purpose=checked_purpose(new,c,r),ticks=r['ticks'],jumps=r['jumps'],shots=r['shots']));continue
  baseline=base[c['id'].split('-counter-')[0]];q1=checked_purpose(old,c,r);q2=checked_purpose(new,c,r);assert q1==q2
  outcome=external_outcome(c,r);prior=counter_classification(c,r,q1,outcome,baseline);current=policy.classify(c,r,q2,outcome,baseline);changed=prior['invalidates_design']!=current['invalidates_design'];row=dict(id=c['id'],purpose=q2,old_invalidates_design=prior['invalidates_design'],new_invalidates_design=current['invalidates_design'],classification=current,changed=changed,outcome=outcome)
  if changed and sample is None:sample=(c,r,q2,outcome,baseline)
  rows.append(row)
assert len(rows)==56 and sum(r['changed']for r in rows)==2
# Rebuild current APIs and confirm only declared metadata differs.
source_equivalent=[]
def strip(c):
 c=copy.deepcopy(c);c['generation_rule'].pop('registration_source',None);c.pop('counter_scope_policy',None);return c
for a,b in zip(old.layouts(old.RECIPES[0],0),new.layouts(new.RECIPES[0],0)):
 assert strip(a)==strip(b);source_equivalent.append(a['id'])
 for aa,bb in zip(old.alternatives(a),new.alternatives(b)):
  assert strip(aa)==strip(bb);source_equivalent.append(aa['id'])
assert len(source_equivalent)==58
# Synthetic defensive checks reuse stored raw; no simulator or new evidence.
c,r,q,o,bl=sample;guards=[]
def run(name,case,raw,check,out,baseline,want):
 result=policy.classify(case,raw,check,out,baseline);assert result['invalidates_design']==want,(name,result);guards.append(dict(test=name,invalidates_design=result['invalidates_design'],scope=result.get('scope'),synthetic=True))
qc=copy.deepcopy(q);qc['reasons'].append('missing_actual_core');qc['ok']=False;run('extra_causal_reason',c,r,qc,o,bl,True)
rr=copy.deepcopy(r);rr['shots']=0;run('zero_shots',c,rr,q,o,bl,True)
bb=copy.deepcopy(bl);bb['ok']=False;run('baseline_failed',c,r,q,o,bb,True)
bb=copy.deepcopy(bl)
for f in bb['frames']:f['frame']+=100
run('alternative_stable_earlier_than_shifted_baseline',c,r,q,o,bb,True)
rr=copy.deepcopy(r)
for f in rr['frames']:
 if f.get('grounded')and abs(f['x']-c['exit_port'][0])<=7 and abs(f['y']-c['exit_port'][1])<=1:f['shot_charges']=0
run('exit_resource_loss',c,rr,q,o,bl,True)
cc=copy.deepcopy(c);cc['counterexample_kind']='independent-review-renamed-counter';run('renamed_nonempty_kind_not_whitelist',cc,r,q,o,bl,False)
result=dict(schema='pcg/N12-independent-pure-classification-audit/v1',new_physics_cases=0,raw_bindings=raw_binding,nominal_full2=nominal,raw_counter_results_checked=56,changed_classifications=sum(x['changed']for x in rows),source_cases_equivalent=source_equivalent,all_purposes_unchanged=True,guards=guards,rows=rows)
Path('/workspace/scratch/block31-review/policy-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2));print('checked56raw,58source,changed2,guards',guards)
